challenge_pt: Posicionar o estúdio não apenas como um grupo de desenvolvedores de jogos trabalhando em projetos, mas como uma república autoproclamada, estruturada e rebelde.
challenge_en: Showcase the studio not only as a group of game devs working on projects but as a structured rebelious self proclamed republic.
body_en:
## Manifest

The manifest represents the vision and mission in a new and fresh way. The use of typewriter typography is intentional to represent a manifesto letter.

## Viva La Revolcion

Bright contrasting colours, erosion, ink splatter, spray, graphitty and other street art elements are the elements that bring the revolutionary motiv to life.
